notes: One verse writes both arms of rule 20: τοὺς ὀφθαλμούς → *his eyes* gives the possessive to the article because no genitive pronoun competes, while τὸ στῆθος αὐτοῦ leaves its article empty because αὐτοῦ carries *his*.
μακρόθεν takes the whole idiom *afar off* headed on *afar*; no ἀπό stands here, so rule 34's pleonastic preposition is not in question.
οὐδέ → *so much as* is headed on *much*, the contentful word; heading on the leading *so* is the competing reading named in the unit's note.
